import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, p, t):
        assert np.ndim(t) == 0
        # a = p
        self.a = p
        # c = a(t)p(2t)
        self.c = self.a(t) * p(2 * t)
